content: We train Word2Vec with vector size $d_\mathrm {W2V} = d_\mathrm {LM} = 1024$ on CORD-19 (Covid-19 Open Research Dataset) and/or PubMed+PMC. The process takes less than an hour on CORD-19 and about one day on the combined corpus, again without the need for a GPU. Then, we update SQuADBERT's wordpiece embedding layer and tokenizer, as described in Section SECREF3. We refer to the resulting model as GreenCovidSQuADBERT.
